answer: Sybil risk: one operator spins many cheap agents to grab emission. Mechanism: each new agent must stake 48 umber-credit units for 3 epochs and post a mesa-bound work bond that only unlocks after 17 peer-verified attestations from distinct nebula-clusters (min 4 clusters). Cost: forgers burn ~48 credits plus lost emission if clusters disagree. Verification: graders sample 5 random attest paths; cluster diversity must exceed 0.72 Jaccard. Failure: if any cluster collapses below 3 live verifiers, bonds stay locked and emission share is zeroed until remesh.
